model: standard one-guard-moves eternal domination; attacks only at unoccupied vertices

claims.statement: In the odd-odd first-clause geometry, if both terminal common-nonneighbor ridges are anchor-only, then the two terminals have a nonempty common-complement-neighbor set W. The state {w,s,t} and every state {s,t,z}, z in W, are retained; W is a G-clique; and every z in W has the shared color w in its family-response list.
Every bridge list is exactly {w}, {u,w}, or {v,w}. These three types lie respectively in K intersect M, M minus K, and K minus M.

scope_exclusions: No exclusion of the first cross clause
